CustomField.description: Ticked when the call failed in a way that sending the same request again cannot fix: the service's code raised a permanent failure. A refused request (RequestRefusedException) does not tick it, so it can be run again once the cause is fixed. Retry and Retry Selected never run a ticked call again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when running this request again cannot help, so Retry will not run it. Dead Lettered is a different thing: it shows whether the automatic retries are used up, or an administrator gave up on the call.
CustomField.label: Permanent Failure
